observations.authors_identification: Rodent marks at 0.3/0.5 mm; grooved 2.1 mm marks attributed to lagomorphs
observations.event_timing: Unknown relative to first transport or deposition; no exposure duration measured

observations.authors_inference: At least two floods needed for complete burial; gnawing supports exposure between deposition and final burial
observations.limits: No item-level field coordinates or crosscutting relations provided here. Thickness comparison assumes nearby beds represent thickness at the carcass.

inference: Reported gnawing supports biological access to bone, conditional on diagnosis. It does not alone locate exposure between two floods or establish a minimum duration.
alternative_sequences: Exposure before transport, followed by burial
Partial burial, exposure and later deposition
Burial followed by re-exposure or burrowing access
discriminating_evidence_needed: Rib identifiers linked to excavation coordinates and beds
Mark photographs and independent taxonomic/morphological review
Field contacts connecting measured section 1 to bone positions
dependence: S101 cites S102; same site and overlapping research team. Neither adds an independent radiocarbon assay.
